deviations.what: The two PROTOCOL.md s7 diagnostics (coherence.py, decomposition.py) were written after the freeze (06:45:10Z) and are not hashed by FREEZE.json. Their content was specified in s7 before the freeze; each output records the digests of its inputs, which verify.py checks.
deviations.effect: none on H1-H4, decisions, planner or tuned results: the diagnostics read no group record and are not hypothesis tests.

deviations.what: decomposition.py prediction(): the first version compared predicted residuals with R[c] - model.med, where R is the full-domain residualisation (coefficients fitted on all samples, including the held-out ones). Changed 9 s after the file was written to Y[c] - model.a - model.b * G[c], the fold's source-fitted residualisation that the predictions use. The script had not been run; its first run started at 06:49:17Z.
deviations.effect: none on any reported number: no output of the first version exists.

deviations.what: Additions to the s7 metric lists: COHERENCE.json also reports pooled AUROC and the top-16 overlap and Spearman correlation between the promoted and coherent scores. DECOMPOSITION.json reports the drug-by-state interaction as the out-of-fold share of the residual that a ridge on 30 basal PCs predicts, not as a separate term of an exact variance split.
deviations.effect: descriptive additions; every s7 metric is also reported.

deviations.what: freeze.py wrote its digests under the key 'sha256_lf'. The repository preflight (tools/research_validation.py) accepted only 'inputs', 'sha256' and 'files', so it refused this freeze as FREEZE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED. FREEZE.json is write-once and was not rewritten; the preflight gained an explicit 'sha256_lf' schema that accepts only the LF-normalised digest, with a test in tests/test_research_validation.py.
deviations.effect: none on any result: the digests are the ones written at the freeze. verify.py checks them independently of the preflight.
